bibl.title: Gallus Reborn. A Study of the Diffusion and Reception of Works Ascribed to Gaius Cornelius Gallus.
bibl.seg: Paul White, Gallus Reborn. A Study of the Diffusion and Reception of Works Ascribed to Gaius Cornelius Gallus. Routledge Focus on Classical Studies.
London - New York, Routledge, 2019, 76 pp. ISBN 978-0-367-72904-2. £16.99.
C.R. par Marie-Pierre Bussières, BMCRev < https://bmcr.brynmawr.edu/2019/2019.10.33 >. - Gary Vos, CR N.S., 70 (2020) pp. 254-256.
bibl.note: Introduction. Neget quis carmina Gallo? - 1. Six elegies ascribed to Cornelius Gallus: Maximianus. - 2. The reception of Gallus-Maximianus. - 3. The carmen ad Lydiam (Lydia bella puella candida). - 4. From senectus to amor. - 5. Elegiacs attributed to Gallus in 1588 (AL 914-917). - 6. The forger of the 1588 elegiacs. - Conclusion. - Appendix. Editiones principes of works ascribed to Gallus, or date of first attribution to Gallus in print. Bibliography.
